title: Additive M3 compact-U(1) conservative candidate contract
question: Can the next Pre-A candidate be specified as a concrete conservative compact/gauge system with an explicit finite observable map while preserving the established T-054 and T-059 methods?
method: Freeze one finite periodic cubic lattice, compact U(1) link variables, complex matter variables, canonical momenta, Hamiltonian, symplectic convention, and Gauss constraint in the additive candidate manifest.
Separate the finite F_reg contract from the unadmitted F_lim, F_eff, and F_obs stages; list the exact dynamic observables and uncertainty obligations without fitting any target.
Carry the existing T-054 forward evidence-first tournament, T-059 observation-first inverse lane, owner order, finite/uniform/physical layer firewall, and stopped-loop rules unchanged.
Register explicit falsifiers and an admission gate requiring primary, independent, hostile, and Lean audits before any candidate scoring or physical interpretation.
finding: A structurally distinct additive candidate can now be resumed from one precise finite contract: compact U(1) link configuration, conservative Hamiltonian dynamics, Gauss-law surface, and gauge-invariant Wilson-loop, plaquette, density, current, and two-time observables. Only F_reg is defined as a design contract. F_lim, F_eff, F_obs, source ownership, uncertainty propagation, continuum control, and prospective holdout remain missing, so the candidate is design-only and not admitted or selected.
decision_scope: T0 Pre-A candidate-design and map-contract scope. The finite formulas are a proposed candidate input, not a proved theorem, numerical result, physical model, or observation fit.
boundary: The record ends at an additive finite design contract. It neither audits nor admits the dynamics, state, gauge quotient, continuum map, effective-theory map, observation map, or holdout.
decision_reason: The frozen Pre-A triage explicitly asks for a genuinely different candidate with conservative dynamics, compact/gauge configuration, and an observable map. This manifest satisfies that design requirement additively without changing any existing method or promoting the candidate. It also makes the missing proof and owner obligations testable rather than implicit.
assumptions: The manifest is the sole source for the proposed finite candidate definition until a versioned owner accepts it.
The local U(1) endpoint convention, plaquette orientation, symplectic sign, and Gauss constraint are frozen exactly as written.
No result is inferred from the word gauge, compactness, or conservative; each property requires the listed audit.
The candidate-neutral dynamic estimand will be frozen before any comparison or target disclosure.
missing_assumptions: A source owner and hash-pinned implementation of the candidate dynamics.
Primary, non-importing independent, hostile, and Lean checks of finite gauge invariance, Poisson preservation, Gauss-law propagation, and flow well-posedness.
A declared state or ensemble, quantum representation if used, and complete uncertainty/covariance/nuisance law.
Uniform regulator, volume, and limit estimates together with counterterms and a fixed limit order.
A complete F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map and a prospective holdout separated from discovery and calibration data.
A common discriminator comparison against M0, M1, M2, and M5 under the existing Pre-A freeze.

adversarial_review.check: Could M3 replace or retune the established T-054 forward or T-059 inverse method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the manifest is additive, design-only, and explicitly preserves both methods and their owner order.

adversarial_review.check: Could compact U(1) notation be promoted to Yang--Mills or Standard-Model identity?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: no physical identification is admitted.

adversarial_review.check: Could a finite Hamiltonian and finite observable map be reported as continuum evidence?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: F_lim is missing and the limit order is not admitted.

adversarial_review.check: Could the candidate be selected by its static energy rather than a frozen dynamic observable?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: a candidate-neutral two-time estimand and source owner are required.

adversarial_review.check: Could the mathematical R0 state be relabeled as physical empty space or Reading-H E?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the manifest explicitly forbids that identification.

adversarial_review.check: Could the proposed gauge and Gauss formulas be called formally verified before a Lean audit?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: no formal result is claimed; Lean is an admission prerequisite.

adversarial_review.check: Could finite parameters be tuned after target disclosure and counted as prediction?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD: all parameters are inserted design inputs and no prediction credit is available.

next_action: Do not score M3 yet. If an owner accepts this version, run the finite primary/independent/hostile/Lean gauge and Gauss contract audit; in parallel continue unchanged T-054 Q3LOCK owner intake and T-059/T-061 supported-runtime and complete-map intake. If no owner accepts it, retain this manifest as a parked design candidate and do not create a substitute finite variant.
stop_or_redesign: If gauge invariance or Gauss propagation fails, reject this candidate version and preserve the failure as a new scoped negative only after the four-lane audit.
If the dynamic observable is invariant over the surviving mobility equivalence class, report non-identifiability rather than selecting a dynamics.
If F_lim, F_eff, or F_obs cannot be defined with a common uncertainty and limit contract, keep M3 at design-only status and do not promote it.
If a future change would modify T-054/T-059 methods or owner order, return to the P0 continuity gate before proceeding.
non_claims: This record does not alter the existing research methods or reopen any parked finite loop.
It does not prove a gauge theory, Yang--Mills dynamics, QFT correspondence, gravity, a physical vacuum, Pre-A, C6, or Sector-A closure.
It does not prove gauge invariance, Gauss-law preservation, finite-flow well-posedness, winding stability, continuum control, or an observation fit.
It does not select M3, fit parameters, reproduce observations, or provide prospective holdout credit.
It does not evaluate the Reading-H physical-empty sign, stationarity, transverse stability, a mass gap, or a theory of everything.
